summary: Fess is an enterprise search server designed to index and retrieve data across various repositories. It provides a centralised search interface that you can integrate into existing systems and web applications. Written in Java and packaged for containerised environments, it handles document indexing and query processing.
goodFor: It suits administrators who need an open-source search engine deployed on their own infrastructure using standard container tools.
watchOut: Enterprise search engines typically demand significant memory and tuning for garbage collection, and configuration can be complex depending on your data sources.
deployNotes: You will typically run this via Docker with persistent volumes attached for index storage, placing a reverse proxy in front to handle TLS termination.
